### UTC Date & Time

Jan 21, 2026, 16:00 UTC

Meeting Room: [Zoom](https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82357016731?pwd=V0hLUWIvU2V2UTdUd216WHdGNFBKUT09)

### Agenda

## Call for Input
- [Call for Input: Force Merge Fusaka Status Changes](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/400)
- [Call for Input: Add Associate EIP Editors](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/398)
- [Call for Input: Best place to host "Call for Input"](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/397)
- [Call for Input: Allow Links to Unicode Technical Standards](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/393)

## Editors’ Discussion
- Suggestions & Issues from EIP Office Hour [85](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-editing-office-hour-eip-only-meeting-85-jan-20-2026/27545/2)
  - Bot's `ToDo` marker should also include `TBD`
  - Create a GitHub label for "Force Merge" and/or "Typo"
  - Bot shouldn't ping Editor, but automerge such [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11115)
  - Linting errors should be avoided [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11113)
-  "Citation" section: Remove "[DRAFT]"?

#### PRs for Editors review and/or consensus 
  - Misc
    - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10966
    - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11042

    - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11021
    - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10792

### Updates on topics from earlier meetings
- Grant more Editors force-merge permissions.
- Best place to host ["Call for Input"](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/397)
- [Network upgrade name and stages](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/add-optional-upgrade-field-to-standards-track-core-eips/27388) on eips.etherum.org 
- [Restructure & rename EIPIP meeting](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/introduce-acd-g-all-core-devs-governance/27387)
- From EIP Office Hour [76](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1775)
  - A collection of _EIP documentation formats_ for test cases and reference implementation at a canonical place for new authors to refer to.
- EIP-1 Updates & Editorial Policies 
  - Contributor.md [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11124)
  - Update to EIP-1 [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11125)

## PR analytics & Editors’ Updates
- Observations from incoming PRs over the past month
  - Increased volume of PRs for "Typo" fixes. Ref [here](https://eipsinsight.com//Analytics#PrLabelsChart) 
- Availability for hosting EIP Editing Office Hours -> add to the [schedule](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1L1_HMqXyYndQZzG3494wcqFcUv9RpzzX67Rdo0UnKqU/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

## EIP Insight
- [January 2026](https://eipsinsight.com/insight/2026/1)

## Community feedback/update 
- Project Showcase or feedback
